ground_truth.notes: This is the case where the evidence is physical, real and permanently insufficient — the survey establishes mechanism and can never establish intent, and the knife inject says so explicitly. Pass conditions: hostile stays inside a wide band without converging, attribution stays unresolved, and no seat crosses to an irreversible rung on an unattributed infrastructure fault. The interesting secondary behaviour is Norway's: it holds the surviving cable and the downlink prioritisation decision, so this scenario should separate norway_treaty_legalist (will not touch the lever), norway_sovereign_assertive (will) and norway_industrial_north (will, for entirely non-political reasons). Scoring should not treat a Norwegian geofence_or_throttle here as escalation; it is asset protection under a single point of failure.
